title: Kung Fu Panda
favouriteScene: Master Oogway's peach tree conversation: 'Yesterday is history, tomorrow is a mystery, but today is a gift. That is why it is called the present.'
favouritePerformance: Jack Black as Po & Dustin Hoffman as Shifu
personalReflections: Often dismissed as a children's comedy, it possesses deeper Daoist philosophical clarity than most adult dramas. There is no secret ingredient—the power is in embracing reality as it is.
